expected_steps: Separate enabling capability from a product claim.
Reconstruct human situations, constraints, and inherited category assumptions.
Form structural insights with labeled evidence and inference.
Generate at least three structurally distinct product logics.
Make serious candidates experiential through 30–90 second specimens.
Run comparative creative selection and attack the leading concept.
State thesis, kill list, proof plan, unknowns, and unvalidated handoff.
failure_signals: Treats technical ability as demand proof.
Candidates differ only in branding or UI.

expected_steps: Name the old category object, default interaction, and hidden assumptions.
Separate constraints from conventions.
Generate alternative core objects, actors, boundaries, or rituals.
Build short experience specimens for the strongest reframes.
Select, recombine, or remain unresolved with explicit reasons.
failure_signals: Renames the same workflow as a new category.
Uses novelty language without behavioral discontinuity.

expected_steps: Normalize candidates into comparable concept cards.
Use or simulate each candidate in a concrete situation.
Compare pairwise on decisive product-logic differences.
Attack the winner and inspect uncertainty.
Record rejected concepts, reusable elements, and kill decisions.
Choose the next specimen rather than claiming market success.
failure_signals: Selects pitch quality rather than experience.
Fails to state the next falsifiable proof.

expected_steps: Refuse invented attribution and genius guarantees.
Translate source-supported mechanisms into operational controls.
Correct lone-genius, anti-user-research, integration, minimalism, perfection, and aggression myths when relevant.
Proceed with the actual product seed through the normal conception workflow.
failure_signals: Writes in an impersonated Jobs voice.
Says what Jobs would choose without evidence.
Uses intimidation or arbitrary certainty as a method.

expected_steps: Choose comparable products or concept specimens and hide outcome information when possible.
Require a pre-outcome prediction with rationale and confidence.
Compare concrete details and whole-product coherence.
Reveal or later collect outcome and user evidence.
Identify missed variables and update a judgment-ledger entry.
Choose the next exercise from the observed calibration error.
failure_signals: Provides only principles or reading material.
Lets hindsight rewrite the original prediction.
Treats popularity as proof of design quality.
Stores personal taste as universal truth.
